Targeting Senior Backend Developer roles with expertise in Node.js while also open to opportunities in Java, Python, or managerial positions, contributing to scalable system design, performance optimization, and cross- functional leadership. Prefer opportunities in Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, or remote setups.

shristiansuka@gmail.com ansukashristi@gmail.com +91 9798128694 linkedin.com/in/shristi-ansuka-b87610151

CORE COMPETENCIES

Backend System Architecture

API Development & Integration

Database Design & Migration

Cloud Infrastructure Optimization

High Availability & Fault Tolerance

Microservices Implementation

Observability & Monitoring

Agile Project Delivery

Stakeholder Collaboration

Performance Tuning & Optimization

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages & Frameworks: Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Express.js

Databases & Search: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch

Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, EventBridge, Auto Scaling), Docker, Linux (Ubuntu), Nginx, PM2, Google APIs

Tools & Architecture: REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, Bitbucket, Shell Scripting, Microservices

Monitoring & Integration: Nagios, Winston, Firebase Cloud Messaging, QuickBooks API

SOFT SKILLS

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Analytical Thinking & Problem-Solving

Adaptability & Continuous Learning

EDUCATION

2020: B.E. in Chemical Engineering, Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra

PERSONAL DETAILS

Languages Known: English, Hindi Address: Pune, Maharashtra, 411028

Shristi Ansuka Senior Software Engineer

PROFILE SUMMARY

Backend Engineering Professional with over 6 years of experience in architecting scalable, resilient, & high- performance server-side systems across cloud-native environments.

Currently working as a Senior Software Engineer with Lognormal.io (OVO Energy), and previously as a Senior Software Engineer at Zentrades, Pune, leading end-to-end back-end development, technical design, and delivery of enterprise-grade solutions.

Skilled in Node.js, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, and Python (working knowledge), with proven expertise in API development, microservices implementation, and enterprise integrations.

Showcased success in cloud infrastructure optimization on AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling), ensuring cost efficiency, scalability, and fault tolerance.

Played a key role in architecture modernization, including transitioning monolithic systems to Microservices and executing seamless database migrations.

Recognized for leading a team of 16 developers and 4 QA engineers, driving sprint planning, feature prioritization, and stakeholder alignment for mission-critical projects.

Strong track record of improving system reliability, reducing outages, and enhancing performance metrics through proactive monitoring, observability platforms, and optimization.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Lognormal.io (OVO Energy) | Senior Software Engineer | Nov 2025 – Present ● Working across a UK energy client's government rebate and customer-support schemes, spanning a Scala

service, a TypeScript monorepo, Terraform infrastructure, and GitOps-based deployments.

Resolved a payment-reporting defect ahead of an external audit by tracing flagged cases to reporting artifacts rather than real duplicate payments, and corrected the logic for a previously unaccounted-for payment channel.

Extended and backfilled production data models across ~65,000 records with zero data-integrity mismatches, making previously unreportable customer data complete and joinable.

Designed and executed a controlled pause and resume of a live third-party integration, draining a backlog of ~5,000 queued records and hardening the batch job after a mid-run infrastructure failure.

Authored technical analyses behind architecture and scheme decisions, presenting options, trade-offs, and recommendations backed by supporting evidence.

Zentrades, Pune | Senior Software Engineer | Jul 2020 – Jul 2025 Growth Path: SDE 4 (Senior Software Engineer) | Mar 2023 – Jul 2025 SDE 3 | Jul 2021 – Feb 2023 SDE 1 | Jul 2020 – Jun 2021

Directed collaboration with 20+ engineers and stakeholders, driving sprint planning and project execution. ● Supervised end-to-end implementation of enterprise solutions including AI agents, client portals, and ACL- based systems.

Implemented observability with Nagios, Winston, and CloudWatch, improving incident detection and resolution.

Deployed high-availability infrastructure using Node.js clusters, PM2, and Nginx, boosting system reliability. ● Executed MongoDB-to-MySQL migration and Monolith-to-Microservices transition, enabling scalability. Projects: QuickBooks API Integration Service ● Engineered a bidirectional sync engine with OAuth 2.0, transactional batch processing, and resilient error

management; integrated FCM for real-time failure alerts, reducing sync inconsistencies.

Inventory Management & Pricing Module ● Developed an event-driven inventory management system (Node.js) to enable real-time stock updates

during procurement and invoicing.

Implemented real-time and scheduled inventory alerts, leveraging FCM, AWS Lambda, and EventBridge, with CSV export for reporting.

Built a configurable pricing engine with a calculator module to apply bulk pricing rules using batch- processing for seamless updates.

AWS Auto Scaling & Infrastructure Optimization ● Configured EC2 auto scaling with CloudWatch triggers, enhancing fault tolerance and resource efficiency

while reducing infrastructure costs.

Key Achievements: ● Directed and mentored a back-end team, driving cross-functional delivery & knowledge sharing; recognized

with a “Growing Leader” award for effective leadership & collaboration.

Consistently maintained 99.9% system uptime, measured bi-weekly and showcased in leadership reviews to demonstrate operational reliability.

● Improved API response times after back-end optimization and query tuning. ● Implemented AWS Auto Scaling, eliminating manual capacity management and saving significant hours

monthly.
